title: Easy Rich Filipino Goat Kaldereta
description: A rich and flavorful Filipino dish featuring goat meat, perfect for a comforting meal, made with cider vinegar and steamed in leaf wraps
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent
Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute until fragrant
Add the goat meat and cook until browned on all sides
Add the cider vinegar, tomato sauce, fish sauce, salt, and black pepper, and stir to combine
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes
Prepare the leaf wraps by cleaning and cutting them into desired sizes
Place a portion of the goat meat mixture onto the center of each leaf wrap
Fold the leaf wraps to form a packet and steam over boiling water for 10 minutes
Serve the kaldereta hot, garnished with additional bay leaves if desired
